msg: 开始调研「AI 写作」的 4 个产品…
Grammarly：读取 32 个页面，记录 6832 字
Copy.ai：读取 26 个页面，记录 7206 字
Jasper：读取 37 个页面，记录 7868 字
Writesonic：读取 41 个页面，记录 7410 字

positioning.value: Grammarly is an AI writing partner that helps users find the words they need for tricky emails, get their point across, and keep work moving, with AI agents supporting every step of the writing process.

target_user.value: The official pricing page segments users into individuals ('Para pessoas físicas'), individuals or teams ('Para pessoas físicas ou equipes'), and large organizations ('Para grandes organizações').

core_capability.value: Grammarly offers AI agents such as Proofreader, Paraphraser, Reader Reactions, and Expert Review; a Humanizer for making AI-generated writing sound more natural; student features including AI Grader, Citation Finder, Plagiarism Checker, and AI Detector; and real-time writing support in more than 25 languages including Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese.

free_tier.value: The free tier costs $0 USD and includes 100 AI prompts per month.

start_price.value: The lowest paid tier is Pro at $12 USD per person per month billed annually; monthly billing is $30.

price_model.value: Pro is priced per person per month, with both annual and monthly billing options. The Enterprise tier does not display a numeric price on the official pricing page.

key_limit.value: Free plan includes 100 AI prompts per month; Pro includes 2,000 AI prompts per month; Enterprise offers unlimited members and unlimited generative AI prompts.

data_policy.value: Grammarly states it never sells user data, does not provide it for advertising purposes, and does not allow third parties to use it to train their models. For Education, Business, Pro, and Enterprise accounts purchased through Sales, Product Improvement and Training is automatically off; multi-user team accounts purchased directly online initially have it on with an admin opt-out.

positioning.value: Jasper 是面向营销人员的首个多智能体平台，帮助企业营销人员以精准且真实符合品牌调性的方式扩展内容和策略。

target_user.value: 面向不同规模的企业和营销团队：从个人营销人员到企业团队，包括社交媒体经理、SEO 专员、广告经理、邮件营销人员及营销负责人，覆盖医疗、金融、零售、电商、SaaS、专业服务等行业，也支持营销代理机构。

core_capability.value: 可基于品牌进行训练，并跨邮件、社交媒体和网站使用；提供 Chrome 和 Edge 浏览器扩展，以及 BigQuery、Google Sheets、Zapier、Make 等 API 集成。

free_tier.value: 无免费版；Pro 计划提供 7 天免费完整功能试用。

start_price.value: 最低付费 Pro 计划为 69 美元/月（月付）或 59 美元/月（年付）。

price_model.value: Pro 按席位/用户计费；Business 为定制报价，通常以 12 个月承诺开始。

key_limit.value: 第三方页面列出的限制为：Creator 1 用户、Pro 1–5 用户、Business 10 用户以上；品牌声音数 Creator 1 / Pro 3 / Business 无限制；Memory 上限 Creator 约 50 件 / Pro 约 150 件 / Business 无限制。官网 Fair Use Policy 未给出具体字数、额度或并发数字。

deployment.value: 云基础部署，提供 Chrome 和 Edge 浏览器扩展，以及通过 API 嵌入外部工具（如 BigQuery、Google Sheets、Zapier、Make 等）；未找到私有化/本地部署的明确说明。

data_policy.value: 官网声明公司数据和输出不会被用于训练第三方 LLM，数据在传输和静态加密；但第三方对隐私政策条款的分析显示，Jasper 可能将用户提交的内容用于训练和改进其自身的 AI 模型，而服务条款又要求此类使用需另行同意。

positioning.value: Copy.ai is the first GTM AI platform built specifically to unify and automate the full go-to-market motion.

target_user.value: Target audience and deployment: Solo / Freelancer / Startup / SMB / Mid- market / Enterprise; targeting revenue teams at startups, SMBs, and enterprise organizations seeking to reduce manual work and increase pipeline efficiency.

core_capability.value: Workflow Builder… Content Automation: Generate SEO blog posts, thought leadership content, use case guides, and social media posts from minimal inputs… Sales Enablement: Automate account research, contact enrichment, champion tracking, and personalized outreach creation… Inbound Lead Processing… Unified Data Flow.

free_tier.value: You can have a completely free account that gives you 2,000 words per month when you sign up. No trial, no credit card.

key_limit.value: Chat plan: 5 seats, unlimited words in chat, unlimited chat projects; Growth plan: 75 seats, 20,000 workflow credits per month; Expansion plan: 150 seats, 45,000 workflow credits per month; Scale plan: 200 seats, 75,000 workflow credits per month.

positioning.value: Writesonic is a one-stop AI engagement platform for all your content needs.

target_user.value: Solo/Freelancer, Startup, SMB, Mid-market, and Enterprise users; reviewers are predominantly small businesses, mid-market companies, freelancers, content creators, and students.

core_capability.value: Provides 100+ AI writing features for brand-consistent content, SEO content, long-form articles over 1500 words, and publishing to 5000+ platforms via Zapier.

free_tier.value: No permanent free plan; offers a 7-day free trial with no credit card required.

price_model.value: Subscription-based pricing with monthly and annual billing options, tiered plans, user seats, project limits, article quotas, site audit quotas, and AI prompt tracking quotas.

key_limit.value: Basic plan: 2 users, 2 projects (up to 4), 100 articles/mo, 40 site audits/mo (1,200 pages), 100 AI prompts tracked/mo; Growth: 5 users, 3 projects (up to 7), 200 articles/mo, 60 site audits/mo (2,500 pages), 200 AI prompts tracked/mo; Enterprise: Custom/Unlimited.

deployment.value: Cloud, browser extension, and API deployment options are available.

data_policy.value: Writesonic does not use Customer Data to train or fine-tune any general-purpose, foundation, or large-language model; it may use de-identified Inputs, Outputs, and Usage Data to operate, secure, debug, evaluate, and improve the Services.
